review.description: Compared glossary terms.json with main: all canonical meanings, aliases, IDs and scopes remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The contributor change means two runner deadline fixtures accelerate their private cleanup observation while retaining original timer-value assertions; production runner cleanup is unchanged; it introduces no product vocabulary.
review.implementation: Reviewed definitions and consuming mappings against main: meanings, UI ownership and product implementations remain unchanged. The Go/UI startup fixtures preload an exact 5000 ms timer recorder and fire only that fixture timer at 100 ms. Existing unresponsive-build cancellation still exercises the real production cleanup timer. Child disappearance, private-state cleanup and supervisor ordering assertions remain active. Four fresh alternating runs on accepted main5097 each passed37/37 tests; baseline mean60.442s and candidate45.702s. Go correctness/performance startup assertions preserve60000/120000ms, UI preserves60000ms, and both assert original5000ms cleanup delay. The unresponsive-build cancellation case has no timer preload, sends SIGTERM twice3s apart and still checks exit143, child disappearance and private-directory cleanup within its existing bounds. Fresh full reconciliation and separate CI remain required.
